# Discovery — New Feature

Scenario-specific prompts for the 10 discovery topics. Use alongside `DISCOVERY-TEMPLATE.md`.

## 1 · Problem
- Who experiences this problem and how often?
- What do they do today when this is unsolved? (Workaround / abandon / call support?)
- What's the cost of not solving it — to the user, to the team, to the business?

## 2 · Users & Stakeholders
- Primary user role and their primary goal in this flow.
- Secondary roles that touch the data (admins, support, partners).
- Engineering stakeholders: which teams own the surfaces this lands on?

## 3 · Goals & Success
- One-sentence outcome statement: "Users can [X] so that [Y]."
- Quantitative metric (adoption %, success rate, time-to-complete).
- Counter-metric (what shouldn't get worse).

## 4 · As-Is Journey
- Today's flow, step by step, including the painful steps.
- Where users drop off, get stuck, or ask for help.

## 5 · To-Be Journey
- Happy path, step by step. Start at user intent, end at user-visible outcome.
- Empty / loading / error / partial-stale states — describe each.

## 6 · Context & Background
- Prior attempts (internal or external) — what worked, what didn't.
- Related systems / features this connects to.

## 7 · Constraints
- Tech stack the feature must live in.
- Performance, accessibility, browser/device targets.
- Compliance / privacy obligations (PII, audit logs, retention).
- Deadline, dependencies on other teams.

## 8 · Approaches
- Option A — minimal viable shape.
- Option B — alternative architecture or scope.
- Trade-offs: time-to-ship, ongoing cost, flexibility.

## 9 · Unknowns & Open Questions
- What user research is missing?
- What technical spike is needed before a confident estimate?

## 10 · Risks & Scope
- Biggest delivery risk (one sentence).
- Sprint count estimate. If > 1, list epics in the Epic Breakdown table.
